title: Speedy Tofu Dan Dan Noodles
subtitle: with Peanut Butter and Pak Choy
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our speedy recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the pak choy and noodles. Trim the pak choy and separate the leaves. Finely chop the spring onion. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Quarter the tofu pieces.
Make sauce: Combine the garlic, peanut butter (see Kitchen notes), Chinese barbecue seasoning, 2 tbs soy sauce, 1 tbs white vinegar and 2 tsp sugar in a bowl.

Cook pak choy and noodles: Cook the pak choy in the pan of boiling water for 1 min or until just tender. Transfer to a bowl with a slotted spoon and return the water to the boil. Add the noodles to the boiling water and cook for 3 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking. Return the noodles to the pan, add 2 tsp vegetable oil and toss to combine.

Warm tofu: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu, turning, for 4 mins or until golden and heated through. Add the sauce and half the spring onion and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until the sauce is slightly thickened. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the noodles, pak choy and tofu mixture among bowls. Scatter over the remaining spring onion and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: Peanut butter can firm up upon sitting, so give it a good mix to soften and bring together. ~ Like it hot? Kick up the heat a notch or two by scattering over chopped fresh chilli or chilli flakes before serving.
